sector: Independent long form interview podcast with a YouTube channel, one guest per episode, made and recorded in the show's own room.
founded_place_size: Started 2021 in Portland, Oregon. A two person show: two hosts, one room, nine episodes a season.
about: DAYDRIFT is a slow, unhurried interview show built around one guest and one real conversation that runs the better part of an hour. It is made by two people in a room they know well, funded by a small paying membership and one renewing sponsor. The promise is intimacy: you are sitting in on a talk between people who like each other, not watching a broadcast.
audience: Regular listeners aged thirty to fifty, most of them listening at work through the day. About two hundred paying members at eight dollars a month, plus a few thousand free listeners who click through to the channel page.
price_positioning: Membership at eight dollars a month with one modest renewing sponsor. Squarely independent: above hobby, well below a network production. The look must read considered and hand made, never broadcast and never scrappy meme.

palette.name: Lamplight Amber
palette.usage: Hairline rules and the keyline around a picture window only, as on daydrift_card_2025.pdf. Never a ground, card, panel or type colour, and never a tint or grade laid on the footage.

palette.name: Deep Room Brown
palette.role: mandatory where a ground, card or panel is used, or where type sits on Foam Cream
palette.usage: Episode titles and the show name on Foam Cream, as the title on daydrift_card_2025.pdf and the one deep ink on daydrift_mic_flag.jpg, and the dark ground or card that type and the show name are reversed out of in Foam Cream.

palette.name: Foam Cream
palette.usage: The light ground and picture-window fill, as on daydrift_card_2025.pdf, and every line of type or show name set on Deep Room Brown or directly over the lamplit footage.

palette.name: Slate Ink
palette.role: mandatory where a guest name, credit or the sponsor line sits on Foam Cream
palette.usage: The guest name, credits and the sponsor line on Foam Cream, as the guest credit and sponsor line on daydrift_card_2025.pdf. Never a ground, card or panel.

palette.name: Muted Sage
palette.usage: A recording date on Foam Cream, as the date on daydrift_card_2025.pdf, and small dividers only. Never a ground, card, panel, title or guest name.

typography: DAYDRIFT runs a warm high contrast serif over a humanist sans, in four steps. Step 01, display, is Romie Regular at 64 px on 78 px leading, tracking -5 units, for episode titles and cover topics on the 1080 by 1350 covers, rising to 72 px on trailers and setting 24 pt on 29 pt in print. Step 02, the subheading, is Romie Italic at 44 px on 52 px leading, tracking -2 units, for the guest name directly under the title, and it is the only slanted type anywhere in the show. Step 03, body, is Cronos Pro Light at 34 px on 48 px leading, tracking 0, for credits and cover copy held to 65 characters a line, with print copy at 9 pt. Step 04, fine print, is Cronos Pro Light at 26 px on 36 px leading, tracking +10 units, for dates and the sponsor line. The show name is never typeset at any step; it stays the flag artwork.
voice: Plain, warm and a little understated, the way two friends actually talk. We never oversell a guest. Example line the brand would write: "Episode eight. We sat down with her for an hour and did not want it to end."
brand_assets_status: There are no brand files left. The show name only survives as artwork on the foam flag on the microphone, drawn years ago by a friend who has since moved away and left no source file. Last season's printed episode card exists only as the print file the printer returned. Everything else has to be rebuilt from those.
values: Honesty and warmth over polish. The show would rather be small and real than slick, and it wants a look it can keep running itself next season without re commissioning.

type_system.signature_move: Italic is reserved for exactly one thing, the guest name in Romie Italic at 44 px directly under every episode title, the only slanted type anywhere in the show.
rules: Never typeset the show name; it stays the flag artwork.
Italic is reserved for the guest name alone; no other step, in any size, slants.
The guest name sits directly under the episode title, never above it and never on the same line.
Episode titles set at 72 px on trailers and 24 pt on 29 pt in print.
Cronos Pro Light sets credits at 34 px, dates and the sponsor line at 26 px, and 9 pt in print.
No step oversells a guest; the title states the subject and stops.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds, cards and panels are Foam Cream or Deep Room Brown and nothing else. On Foam Cream, the episode title and the show name are Deep Room Brown, and the guest name, credits and the sponsor line are Slate Ink, as on daydrift_card_2025.pdf; a recording date may be Muted Sage. On Deep Room Brown, and wherever type sits directly over the lamplit footage, all type and the show name are Foam Cream. Lamplight Amber (hairline rules and picture-window keylines) and Muted Sage (a date line or small dividers) together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-footage area and are never a ground, card, panel, title or guest name.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, on the covers and on every held frame of the films. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no translucent scrim, gradient or tinted overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over the footage or a frame taken from it: a text card sits over or beside the footage as a solid block. A straight cut or a plain fade between shots is a transition, not a tint.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, cards, panels, rules, keylines or the show name, plain white and black included. No gradient, glow or drop shadow on any type, card or the show name, and the show name is never shown as a photograph of the foam flag.
palette_rules.photography: The supplied footage (daydrift_ep02.mp4, daydrift_ep02_room_02.mp4, daydrift_ep05.mp4, daydrift_ep05_table_02.mp4, daydrift_ep08.mp4 and daydrift_ep08_room_02.mp4) and any frame taken from it are never tinted, duotoned or graded toward the palette, Lamplight Amber included: the lamplit rooms are not warmed further to match it. A correction confined to the lamp side of daydrift_ep08.mp4 is allowed.
